user_id.description: Constraints: PK, AUTO_INCREMENT | Unique user identifier

role_id.description: Constraints: FK → ROLES, NOT NULL | User's assigned role

first_name.description: Constraints: NOT NULL | Legal first name

last_name.description: Constraints: NOT NULL | Legal last name

email.description: Constraints: UNIQUE, NOT NULL | Login email address

phone.description: Constraints: UNIQUE, NOT NULL | Mobile phone number

is_email_verified.description: Constraints: DEFAULT FALSE | Has the user verified their email

is_phone_verified.description: Constraints: DEFAULT FALSE | Has the user verified their phone

is_active.description: Constraints: DEFAULT TRUE | Account active / deactivated status

is_banned.description: Constraints: DEFAULT FALSE | Whether the account is banned

ban_reason.description: Constraints: NULLABLE | Reason for ban (if banned)

profile_picture_url.description: Constraints: NULLABLE | URL to avatar / profile image

referral_code.description: Constraints: UNIQUE, NULLABLE | Customer's own referral code

referred_by.description: Constraints: FK → USERS, NULLABLE | user_id of the referring customer

created_at.description: Constraints: DEFAULT NOW() | Account creation timestamp

last_login.description: Constraints: NULLABLE | Most recent login timestamp
